value.name: open jewelry case
value.description: Asha lifts the lid of the case to see what is inside.

value.name: reveal hidden journal
value.description: Lucia moves aside the jewelry and pulls out a small leather-bound journal hidden beneath it.
evidence: Lucia closed her eyes for a breath, then leaned forward and lifted the jewelry aside to draw out a small leather-bound journal that had been pressed flat beneath it.

value.name: present journal to Asha
value.description: Lucia places the journal on Asha's knee without opening it herself.
evidence: She set it across Asha's knee without opening it herself

value.name: discover witnessed codicil
value.description: Asha finds a loose half-sheet in the journal that matches the codicil and bears Lucia's witnessed signature.
evidence: Asha turned past the first few household pages until she found the loose half-sheet tucked between them: the same shaky hand as the codicil downstairs, the same date, and beneath the signature a second name in a steadier script — Lucia's own, witnessed and dated the same afternoon.

value.name: confirm Lucia's complicity
value.description: Asha looks to Lucia for confirmation, and Lucia's silent response confirms she has been carrying this secret since the funeral.
evidence: Asha looked up. Lucia did not nod, exactly; she only kept her hand on the edge of the drawer and met the look, which was confirmation enough and also the thing she had been carrying alone since the funeral.

value.name: ignore Daniel's calls
value.description: Daniel keeps calling Asha's name from below, but neither woman answers him yet.
evidence: Below them, through the floorboards, Daniel's voice went on saying Asha's name, but in the sewing room neither of them answered it yet.

value.name: hide journal and secure case
value.description: Asha protects the loose sheet by laying the journal over the folder, then closes and locks the velvet case.
evidence: Asha laid the journal flat across the folder on the chair so the loose half-sheet sat protected between leather and cardstock, then closed the velvet case over the garnets and turned the small brass lock back into place.

value.name: keep key in hand
value.description: Asha chooses not to pocket the key and instead keeps it in her palm.
evidence: She did not put the key in her pocket; she kept it in her palm.

value.name: Daniel warns about misunderstanding
value.description: Daniel speaks from the hallway, trying to frame the situation as a possible misunderstanding about the papers.
